questions.question: The First Battle of Panipat (1526) was fought between:
questions.rationale: Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi and founded Mughal rule. Akbar-Hemu was Panipat II (1556) and Abdali-Marathas was Panipat III (1761).

questions.question: Which battle of 1527 saw Babur defeat the Rajput confederacy?
questions.rationale: Khanwa (1527) was fought against Rana Sanga of Mewar. Chanderi (1528) was against Medini Rai.

questions.question: The Second Battle of Tarain (1192) resulted in the victory of:
questions.rationale: Muhammad of Ghor won in 1192 after losing in 1191. Jaichand was defeated at Chandawar in 1194.

questions.question: Which battle was fought in 1539 between Sher Shah Suri and Humayun?
questions.rationale: Chausa was in 1539 and Kannauj in 1540. Samugarh (1658) was a war of succession between Aurangzeb and Dara Shikoh.

questions.question: Haldighati (1576) was fought between Maharana Pratap and a Mughal army led by:
questions.rationale: Akbar sent Raja Man Singh of Amber. Bairam Khan commanded at Panipat II in 1556.

questions.question: The Battle of Plassey in 1757 was fought between:
questions.rationale: Clive won at Plassey with Mir Jafar's support. Munro fought at Buxar (1764) and Coote at Wandiwash (1760).

questions.question: Which battle led to the Treaty of Allahabad and the grant of diwani to the British?
questions.rationale: After Buxar (1764), the Treaty of Allahabad (1765) gave the Company the diwani of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa.

questions.question: Which Mughal-era battle is correctly matched with its winner?
questions.rationale: In 1556 Akbar's forces under Bairam Khan beat Hemu. At Panipat III Abdali won; Prithviraj won Tarain I, and Sher Shah won Chausa.

questions.question: The Third Battle of Panipat was fought in:
questions.rationale: 1761 saw Ahmad Shah Abdali defeat the Marathas. The other years are Panipat I, Panipat II and the Revolt.

questions.question: Tipu Sultan died defending Seringapatam in the:
questions.rationale: Tipu fell in 1799. The Third War ended with the Treaty of Seringapatam in 1792, when he lost half his territory.

questions.question: Who led the Ahoms to victory over the Mughals at Saraighat?
questions.rationale: Lachit Borphukan won at Saraighat in 1671 against Ram Singh's Mughal army.

questions.question: The Anglo-Sikh Wars ended with:
questions.rationale: After the second war (Chilianwala and Gujrat), Dalhousie annexed Punjab in 1849. The other treaties belong to Maratha and Mysore wars.

questions.question: Which pair is correct for the independent-India wars?
questions.rationale: Pakistan's forces surrendered at Dhaka on 16 December 1971. The Tashkent Declaration was January 1966, 1962 was with China, and Kargil was Operation Vijay.

questions.question: Which battle destroyed the power of Vijayanagara in 1565?
questions.rationale: The Deccan sultanates defeated Vijayanagara at Talikota (Rakshasa-Tangadi) and Rama Raya was killed. Raichur (1520) was a Vijayanagara victory.
